subject: opening day help!!
body:
Hey there,

We're opening The Scoop Shack in Boise on March 27th (!!) and I just realized we don't have cups. Need 3,000 12 oz cups with our full color logo (it has a gradient in it, hope that's ok). Is that even possible in time? Budget is tight so please tell me the total.

Marcus
needs_human_reason: $875 order. The standard in-house lead time (7-10 business days) can meet the Mar 27 opening if the proof is approved quickly. No rush or guarantee requested; all answers are in the KB.
summary: New shop opening Mar 27 needs 3k 12 oz full-color (gradient) cups. In-house digital, $875; tight, so the proof needs approval ASAP.
draft_reply:
Hi Marcus,

Congrats on the opening! Yes, it's possible, but it's tight, so let's move fast. 3,000 12 oz cups with your full-color logo come to $875.00 total, and the gradient is no problem on our in-house digital press.

3,000 x $0.26 = $780.00
Setup: none
Freight: $95.00 flat (orders under $2,500)
Total: $875.00

Timing: in-house cups ship 7-10 business days after you approve the digital proof. If the proof is approved by Tuesday, March 9, they'd ship around March 18-23, ahead of your March 27 opening. Transit time is on top of that and we can't guarantee a delivery date, so every day the proof waits eats into your cushion.

One heads-up: digital printing is a close color match, not an exact Pantone match.

If you can send your logo today as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG) along with your Boise ship-to address, we'll turn the proof around right away. A 50% deposit starts production and the balance is due before shipping. This quote is an estimate, good for 30 days, and doesn't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
assumptions: Proof approval assumed by Tue Mar 9 for the ship window.
owner_note: Tight but doable on standard lead time. The team should chase the artwork today.
quote:
REQUEST: 3,000 x 12 oz custom cups, full color

RECOMMENDED: In-house digital (3,000 x 12 oz)
  Cups: 3,000 x $0.26 = $780.00
  Setup: none for in-house digital = $0.00
  Subtotal: $780.00
  Freight: $95.00 flat (subtotal under $2,500.00)
  TOTAL: $875.00
  Lead time: 7-10 business days after proof approval; ships approx Thu Mar 18 - Tue Mar 23 if the proof is approved by Tue Mar 9 (transit time not included)
  Need-by Sat Mar 27: tight
  Color: Close color match only. No Pantone (PMS) guarantee.

NOT AVAILABLE AS ASKED:
  USA partner (flexographic): USA partner (flexographic) minimum is 10,000 cups; USA partner prints spot colors only (max 4); full color, gradients, or photos need in-house digital or overseas
  Overseas (offset): Overseas (offset) minimum is 50,000 cups

Terms: estimate valid 30 days, excludes sales tax; 50% deposit to start, balance before shipping; digital proof with every order.
